name: @relaymessenger/cookbook-group-chat-agents
description: Several Relay agents in one group chat with a person: each hears every message, may stay silent, and takes its turn in order.

scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler deploy --env alan && wrangler deploy --env grace
scripts.dry-run: wrangler deploy --dry-run && wrangler deploy --env alan --dry-run && wrangler deploy --env grace --dry-run
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run dry-run
